description: Supplemental RDAP servers for IDN ccTLDs, keyed by A-label (xn--). Split from cctld-rdap-servers.json so the ASCII and Punycode namespaces stay separately reviewable. Each entry is independently probed by this project (see evidence) and re-checked by the monitor workflow. IANA always wins: an entry here is used only when IANA does not already cover the TLD.
